name: Astamon
main_effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] You may delete 1 of your other purple Digimon to digivolve this Digimon into a Digimon card with [Belphemon] in its name in your hand without paying its digivolution cost.
source_effect: [Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] When a card is trashed from your hand, you may play 1 level 4 or lower purple Digimon card from your trash without paying its cost.
